title: Comtrade API collection: technical smoke test
purpose: Technical retrieval evidence only; no trade values or approved economic observations.

earlier_attempts.reason: Initial handler rejected absent content-type metadata despite a preserved HTTP 200 JSON body.
Header-case normalization did not resolve absent metadata; receipt preserved.

interpretation_limits: No data reported is not zero trade.
A complete HTTP body is not complete economic coverage.
A current retrieval for 202501 is not evidence of what was published or received in 2025.
The final handler permits missing media type only into quarantine with an explicit blocker; wrong media types or invalid JSON still fail.
Raw responses and staging rows remain in ignored local output storage and are not redistributed in this artifact.
No continuous collector, deployed scheduler, approved source adapter or real-time market-data service is claimed.
